operations: three-layer mechanical, pneumatic and electrical construction
seamless periodic idle and analysis loops
global peak normalization with summing headroom

cues.idle: Very restrained deep electrical machine-room hum; seamless eight-second loop.
cues.focusLeft: Dry low electrical contact impact, with no beep or melodic locator.
cues.focusRight: Mirrored dry electrical contact impact, differentiated only by restrained cabinet resonance.
cues.loadSubjects: Heavy motor travel, commutated servo, rail friction, end-stop mass and pneumatic pressure release.
cues.chamberLock: Low servo pre-roll, multi-resonant steel bolt impact and compressed-air discharge.
cues.scan: Narrow electromagnetic friction, controlled current texture and low carriage vibration; no laser chirp.
cues.startAnalysis: Breaker engagement, deep power intake and cabinet vibration.
cues.analysisLoop: Seamless deep generator hum, mechanical vibration and restrained commutator rhythm, accelerated by runtime playback rate.
cues.blackout: Very short breaker trip and low energy collapse, followed by deliberate silence until reveal.
cues.reveal0: Cold administrative matte impact and brief pressure discharge.
cues.reveal1: Precise low impact, controlled electrical response and restrained relay return.
cues.revealM: Deep sub impact and full-machine mechanical/pressure response without rise, melody or victory gesture.
cues.reset: Motor rundown, pneumatic vent and heavy low landing before idle resumes.

introSequences.introBoot: Reuses the idle machine-room hum at reduced level and playback rate for a restrained low initialization bed.
introSequences.introIdentify: Reuses the dry focus-left electrical contact at reduced level for a short matte institutional acknowledgement.
introSequences.introEnter: Layers the existing heavy motor travel with a restrained power-intake cue, then crossfades into the normal idle bed.
introSequences.assetDecision: No sprite regeneration: the existing project-owned layers cover the requested palette without adding redundant material.

fingerprintSequences.fingerprintFocus: Reuses the matching focusLeft/focusRight matte contact at 0.09 runtime gain for an almost silent acknowledgement.
fingerprintSequences.fingerprintPress: Reuses the seamless analysisLoop at 0.075 gain; left runs at 0.74x and right at 0.79x so concurrent chambers remain distinct without excessive summing.
fingerprintSequences.fingerprintRelease: Fades only the released chamber loop over 70 ms, then stops its Howler voice to avoid ticks and stale instances.
fingerprintSequences.fingerprintSync: Replaces held voices with one shared analysisLoop voice. Over 1.8 seconds it rises from 0.88x/0.10 gain to 1.20x/0.23 gain; release cancels the ramp and restores idle.
fingerprintSequences.fingerprintConfirmed: Reuses chamberLock as the single matte mechanical confirmation. The immediately following startAnalysis handoff suppresses its startAnalysis and chamberLock transients, then retains scan, analysis-loop acceleration and blackout.
fingerprintSequences.cancellation: Reset, destroy and document visibility loss clear held voices, the shared sync voice and all scheduled ramp steps.
fingerprintSequences.assetDecision: No sprite regeneration: focus contacts, the seamless analysis loop and chamber lock already provide the required mature clinical-industrial palette.

accessTerminalSequences.accessTerminalFocus: Reuses the matte focus-left contact at 0.045 runtime gain for a nearly silent terminal presence cue.
accessTerminalSequences.accessScanStart: Reuses the seamless analysis loop at 0.68x playback rate and 0.085 gain, with a 120 ms fade-in, for a low clinical scanner hold.
accessTerminalSequences.accessScanCancel: Fades and stops only the terminal scanner voice over 120 ms, avoiding clicks without touching later chamber fingerprint holds.
accessTerminalSequences.accessGranted: Fades the scanner, layers the existing heavy chamber lock at 0.38 gain with a short power-intake response at 0.20 gain and 0.9x rate after 210 ms, then ensures the restrained idle bed after 920 ms. No chime or arcade validation gesture.
accessTerminalSequences.lifecycle: Terminal focus, scanner and granted calls are idempotent within their state. Reset, destroy and document visibility loss clear the scanner voice and all terminal-only timers.
accessTerminalSequences.assetDecision: No sprite regeneration: the existing project-owned contact, seamless generator, mechanical lock and power-intake layers cover the terminal palette without new assets or licence obligations.
